scope: Real per-unique-scorer trajectories for four non-learned simple-search methods on the 18-record development panel; no external-method dense imputation, functional labels, CodonFlow generator result, or SOTA designation
population: 18 unique development records only; no untouched24, functional untouched, MAGE test, Ribo test, or functional assay labels
initialization: synonymous_x0(source, numpy.default_rng(seed * 1009)); identical initial state across methods within a record-seed
budget_rule: Budget 1 is the initial state. Each previously unscored legal sequence consumes exactly one budget; cache hits consume terminal requests but no unique-scorer budget. Every integer budget 1..500 must have one real finite objective vector.

dense_metric.name: dense_budget_step_auc_v2
dense_metric.endpoint: HV_500 is reported but excluded from AUC

ned_rule: Mean pairwise Levenshtein/max(length), exact all-pairs at B=50/100; deterministic 200-of-500 sequence subsample with numpy default_rng(0) at B=500, matching the frozen pairwise_ned convention

statistics.unit: one record; arithmetic mean of its three seeds before paired inference
statistics.effect_direction: method minus uniform; positive favors method
statistics.ci_method: two-sided percentile paired bootstrap over record indices
statistics.p_value: two-sided paired sign-flip with plus-one correction, capped at 1
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over six primary tests: three methods x two endpoints
statistics.success_rule: 95% CI lower bound > 0 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; otherwise no supported advantage

execution.order: benchmark FASTA order, then seed ascending, then protocol method order
execution.resume: skip only byte-stable completed run JSON with matching protocol/input/initial-state identity and 500 points; never accept partial output
execution.smoke: C01H6.8b.1, seed 0, all four methods, B=20, one worker, separate non-formal artifact root

cost.report: per-run wall clock, objective-scoring time, residual generation/cache/proposal time, terminal requests and unique scorer calls
cost.parallelism_note: four independent runs may execute concurrently; observed per-run costs are not unified or time-matched to external baselines

external_actual_sets: LinearDesign/EnsembleDesign and other unordered actual-output sets retain dense_budget_step_auc_v2=null; no zero filling or lambda-to-budget conversion
decision_boundary: Development proxy-design search only. Even a positive simple-search comparison does not establish functional effectiveness, CodonFlow-RK improvement, RK-G1, external SOTA, untouched generalization, or generator authorization.
